orientation: Point the nose along open floor before arming. Do not aim at people or exhibits.
area: One floor mark beside the dog. The path never flies over the dog.
landing_patch: the same floor mark; back 20 cm, then land
abort: One takeoff only. If a later move fails, return only when the outbound move was confirmed, then land once. An unconfirmed landing stays unknown and is not retried.
